name: evaluation_error_broken_role
description: role=broken's fixture-policy rule references context.amount without a 'has' guard. Omitting the 'amount' argument entirely makes Cedar itself report a genuine internal evaluation error (not a simulated/hand-rolled one). decision.Engine forces DENY whenever Cedar reports an error, regardless of what Cedar's own diagnostic decision would otherwise have been. G1 checkpoint scenario: 'policy/evaluation error'. Proves an authorization failure can never be converted to ALLOW.
